errorCodes.meaning: The recipient holds no group state for `roomId` as `member` — or `member` is not one the caller may act as, which is answered the same way so that the error does not say which members of which rooms the recipient serves. A room absent from rooms/keys/list for this member has no read marker.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

ReadMarker.description: Where a member has seen one room's conversation up to: the room version they have seen it to, and the host's `createdAt` of the newest message they have seen. A reader that keeps a copy of the room counts as unread a message first stored after `version`; a reader that keeps no copy counts one whose `createdAt` (else `updatedAt`) is after `createdAt` (rooms/changed, What a reader does with a signal, step 4). Markers are ordered by `version`, then by `createdAt` (an absent `createdAt` before any present one): the greater is further on. Carries nothing about which messages, who wrote them, or when the member read them.

createdAt.description: The host's `createdAt` of the newest message the member has seen, the member's own included — else its `updatedAt` where the host kept no `createdAt` for it — exactly as the host returned it. For a reader that keeps no copy of the room. Absent when the member has seen no message in the room. Never the author's `writtenAt`, which a writer chooses, and never when the member read it.

version.description: The highest room version the member has seen the conversation to: every message the room held at or below this version has been shown to them. `0` means none: the member has seen nothing in the room, which is what marking a whole room unread sets. A room version as rooms/records/list returns it, never a count of messages.

Response.description: Success response to rooms/keys/read-marker/set. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/keys/read-marker/set/0.1#response. The marker now in force, which the caller adopts, and whether this request moved it.

moved.description: `true` when this request changed the marker. `false` when the marker held was already as far on — or, for a rewind, already equal: nothing was written. A retried request answers `false`, which is what makes the task safe to repeat.

readMarker.description: The marker now in force: the requested one when it moved the marker, else the one the key holder already held — further on, because another of the member's devices had read further.

schema.description: Tell the member's key holder where the member has now seen one room's conversation up to. The key holder keeps the further of the marker it holds and this one — the greater `version`; at equal `version`, the later `createdAt` — unless `rewind` asks it to take this one even when it is behind. Kept for the member alone: nothing here reaches the room, its host, its owner, another member or a community. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

member.description: The member whose marker this is: the DID the room admitted, as rooms/keys/list 0.3 returns it beside the room. REQUIRED, never inferred, because a person holding one room as two personas keeps a marker for each.

readMarker.description: Where the member has now seen the conversation up to. Without `rewind`, kept only if it is further on than the marker the key holder holds.

rewind.description: Take `readMarker` even when it is behind the marker held: "mark as unread". Only `true` is meaningful, so only `true` is accepted; absent, the marker only moves forward.

roomId.description: The room's identifier: its DID, as rooms/keys/list returns it.
